page.content:
Short statement of what Wikipedia is and is not.

How Five pillars connects

  • Topic: Neutral point of view — Neutral point of view is the first of the Five pillars.
  • Work: English Wikipedia — The Five pillars are English Wikipedia's short statement of principle.
  • Topic: No original research — No original research is enforced as a core content policy beside the pillars.

What is Five pillars?

The Five pillars summarize the encyclopedia: NPOV, free content, no original research in the civility sense of conduct, and that Wikipedia has no firm rules — a doorway to the longer policy set.

Key threads lead to Neutral point of view, English Wikipedia and No original research.
